answer: Each agent identity must lock a per-key stake inside a sealed enclave before it may act. To run a thousand puppets an attacker posts a thousand deposits plus thousand attestation fees, and refunds only clear after the holding period while proven clones forfeit the stake. Entry cost thus rises straight with headcount, exceeding any reward a flood of votes earns. One honest deposit pays for itself, so the pulse of new keys stays near the honest baseline: a quartz-hard floor that makes marginal sybils unprofitable wherever the wharf clears.
